description:
An alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform

Keyguard is an alternative client for the Bitwarden® platform, created to provide the best user experience possible.
Highlights:
- a beautiful rich and responsive Material You user interface;
- a powerful and fast search;
- a support for creating & using passkeys - a modern alternative to passwords.
- a watchtower that finds items with Pwned passwords, Vulnerable accounts, Reused passwords, Inactive two factor authentication, Inactive passkeys, Unsecure Websites as well as Duplicate, Incomplete and Expiring items, and other;
- multi-account support 🌠 with secure login and two-factor authentication support;
- add items 🌠 and sends 🌠, modify 🌠, and view your vault offline;
- export individual or organization items, including the attachments;
- beautiful Light/Dark theme;
- a generator with SSH keys, Email forwarders, Custom wordlists support, and many other features;
- a support for placeholders and URL overrides;
- and much more!
🌠 - on Android requires the Premium one-time or subscription license.
This release adds experimental native passkey support on Windows, preview for ZIP archive attachments, and the Environment item type.
New
- Windows: Added experimental native passkey support (#991).
- Android: Added Termux addon for GPG agent (#1642).
- Attachments: Added preview for ZIP archive attachments.
- Vault: Added the Environment item type.
Improvements
- GPG: Item details screen now shows Expiry, Keygrip, and Keyserver status.
- GPG: Keyserver lookups are now safer and support fingerprint QR codes.
- GPG: Multiple User IDs can now be managed and appear as separate items.
- Vault: Account and Item IDs now include copy actions.
Security
- SSH agent: PPK imports now require integrity verification.
- GPG: Unsigned cleartext OpenPGP headers are now rejected.
Fixes
- Desktop: Fixed a crash when scrolling the unread alert list in Watchtower.
- Desktop: Fixed Watchtower background checks so they start.
- macOS: Fixed process caller detection so it detects the outermost .app.
- Bitwarden: Fixed sync so it skips unsupported Send types instead of failing.
- Passkeys: Fixed passkey selection so only passkeys the authenticator can sign with are offered.
- SSH agent: Fixed the agent so it accepts nonzero SSH forwarding flags and refuses unknown extensions.
- GPG: Fixed the agent so it matches the GPG version on non-sandboxed environments.
- GPG: Fixed key handling so the same key can be stored in multiple items.
- GPG: Fixed binary key imports so key files are read as bytes.
- GPG: Fixed the agent so SIGKEY is treated as an alias of SETKEY.
- Vault: Fixed archived items so they are not indexed or used by GPG and SSH agents.
- Accounts: Fixed account setup so the same Bitwarden or KDBX account cannot be added twice.
- Unlock: Fixed the elevated access dialog so it sends a Deny event when dismissed.
- WebDAV: Fixed malformed URLs so they are handled gracefully.
